description: Link another of this merchant's deployed contract sets on the same chain to an unconfigured draft, or switch a live site. For a live switch explicitly provide confirmLive:true and expectedVault from the last read; another live site must keep serving the previous vault so depositors retain withdrawal access. Funds stay in the previous vault. The backend enforces these guards. Requires JWT.
name: yield_deployments_contracts_link
title: Select existing vault contracts
